result.instructions: Tools for Engagedly, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List all departments and how many people work in each."; "Who reports to Adam Smith?"; "Which certificates expire in the next 90 days?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Engagedly data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run engagedly_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run engagedly_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run engagedly_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. engagedly_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: engagedly_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List employees with name, email, status, title, employee id and manager data. Filter by email. Use include to embed primary_reporter or direct_reports. API: GET /beta/users.

email.description: Return only the user with this email address.

tools.description: Get one user by id, with profile fields and optional related data. API: GET /beta/users/{id}.

tools.title: Get user permissions
tools.description: Get the permissions of one user. API: GET /beta/users/{id}/permissions.

tools.name: engagedly_list_learning_resources
tools.title: List learning resources
tools.description: List courses and playlists with filters (title text, type, language, provider, level, tags, duration, certified, archived, short code). Each item has an id and a short_code. API: GET /beta/learning/resources.

providers.description: Content providers, for example engagedly, udemy, go1.

short_code.description: Return the resource with this exact short code.

certified.description: Only resources that grant a certificate.

archived.description: true = archived only; default is active only.

sort.description: Sort field, prefix with - for descending order.

size.description: Items per page, 1 to 50 (default 15 for learning).

tools.name: engagedly_get_learning_resource_contents
tools.title: Get learning resource contents
tools.description: Get the content hierarchy (sections and items) of one course or playlist. API: GET /beta/learning/resources/{id}/contents.

tools.name: engagedly_get_learner_report
tools.title: Get learner report
tools.description: Report of learner progress per course or playlist. Filter by resource ids or types. API: GET /beta/learning/learner_reports.

learning_resource_ids.description: Internal course ids to report on.

tools.name: engagedly_list_certificates
tools.title: List certificates
tools.description: List certificates awarded to employees (name, authority, validity dates). Filter by user, term, dates or status. API: GET /beta/certificates.

term.description: Search on certificate name or authority.

start_date.description: Valid on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

end_date.description: Valid on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).
